errors.searches: grep 'Lopez'; grep 'nothing to do with commerce'; grep 'any sort of economic enterprise'

The substance (Lopez as a commerce-power limit) is fully supported; the defect is a dropped word in a quote marked verbatim. MINOR-DRIFT.
